name: output-channel-contract
description: Three output channels per tool: content[0].text = TOON-encoded (LLM-visible data), details = plain struct (agent metadata + renderResult inputs), renderResult = TUI card reading from details. Never TOON-encode details — breaks renderResult. TOON only for content[0].text.

name: tool-registration
description: Each tool: registerTool with pi metadata, TypeBox schema, execute handler, structured details, visible content.text, optional renderResult. Source, compiled output, and tests agree on parameter names. camelCase for pi schema exposure. Structured details = source of truth for agents.

name: streaming
description: find/grep/shell stream via throttled onUpdate (500ms makeThrottle). onUpdate carries content:[] — LLM sees no partial TOON. TOON encoded once at finalization. renderResult gets isPartial:true while streaming. Kill handle from runner for limit abort. ast_search not streaming (ast-grep emits JSON array not JSONL).

name: universal-ops-schema
description: Every tool uses {ops: Op[]} where Op is discriminated by op field (TypeBox Literal). Single op = one-element array. Mixed op types per call. New capability = new op variant added to union; tool interface never changes. Execute dispatches on op. TOON merges results across all ops. Replaces edits[], files[], commands[], action fields.

name: linehash-cli-boundary
description: Heavy file-op logic belongs in linehash CLI not Pi extension TypeScript. Extension is thin adapter: registerTool, TypeBox schema, hook registration, encodeToon, renderResult, details shaping, display helpers, streaming+throttle, truncation. linehash owns: fuzzy matching, snapshot, diff, anchored diff, symbol edit, patch-apply.

name: nu-foundation
description: All backend tool execution runs through Nu foundation layer in Flox env. Flox pins: nu, rg, fd, eza, bat, delta, ast-grep, linehash, sd. Activated at pi-dev.ts launcher. Nu wrappers in nu/lib/ (grep/find/ls/read/diff/query/bat/sd). TypeScript extension → thin adapter only. JSON parsing moves to Nu.

name: defense-in-depth
description: Four layers: 0=AgentFS(FUSE/SQLite COW)+YoloFS(staging/snapshots) filesystem boundary; 1=profile tool whitelist (registerTool only for allowed); 2=profile op whitelist (TypeBox schema union restricted); 3=own dcg(.toml pattern packs)+Reinforced Agent reviewer(light.sock)+slb peer approval. Outer layer cannot be bypassed by compromised inner.

title: Vendored compiled pi binary
rationale: Compile @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent with bun build --compile; apply patch-pi before compilation so patches are baked in. No node_modules at runtime. Extensions bundle all deps inline (pi-tui, typebox, toon, diff; no --external flags). pi-coding-agent moved to devDependencies. data.tar.gz contains no node_modules.

title: Extension bundling strategy
rationale: bun build each extension to index.js with no --external flags. pi-tui bundled inline (safe: compiled pi has its own separate copy, duck-typed rendering; Nix pi proved separate instances work). pi-coding-agent is type-only in extensions so tree-shaken away. Installed data dir is self-contained: no bun, no npm required at runtime.

title: Senshac Quality Gates and Universal Tool Contract Verification
rationale: Enforces zero-drift contracts across all basic-tools and context tools, preventing breaking API changes and ensuring CI parity.

title: Nix-Native Packaging & Warren Agent Integration
rationale: In-tree updaters and vendored binary blobs break container immutability, dockerTools layer deduplication, and unprivileged user runtimes in Warren sandboxes. Pure Nix packaging guarantees glibc consistency, reproducible caching, and clean RPC mode execution.

title: External models only without in-tree model runner
rationale: Eliminates hardcoded local ports and delegates model configuration to standard Pi provider env vars.

title: Use herdr for sessions instead of Zellij
rationale: Zellij multiplexer fails in minimal Warren distroless containers. herdr is already the project's native process daemon and IPC manager.

title: Consolidate project-context and @filepath references
rationale: Combines macro-context (workspace AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) and micro-context (@filepath expansion) into a single clean extension, removing the vendored symlink.

title: Evolve context into Engram and compaction bridge
rationale: Removes .pi-context/ disk clutter from repos and ensures active state is automatically preserved in Engram on session_before_compact.

title: Autonomous YOLO mode over interactive safe-prefix gates
rationale: Interactive permission prompts deadlock headless Warren agents and autonomous tasks. OS container boundaries and burrow provide isolation without halting execution.

title: Project Context and Baked-in File Reference Implemented
rationale: Upstream issue #104 context discovery and @filepath reference expansion unified into project-context, removing vendored submodule and preserving KV cache with tail messages

title: Upstream Feature Triage for Autonomous Warren Runtime
rationale: Triage upstream itayinbarr/little-coder v1.20 features to adopt high-leverage runtime guards while discarding benchmarking and shell redundancies superseded by Warren/herdr

title: Devenv Binary Distribution Over install.sh
rationale: install.sh curl-pipe installer removed in favor of pure Nix derivation packaging and devenv executable wrapper

title: Context Watchdog Implemented for Autonomous Runs
rationale: Mid-run token monitoring prevents context overflow in autonomous multi-step tool loops without human prompts

title: Implement extra-tools extension
rationale: Provide Volition-style active clipboard, Lean-CTX JIT outlines, compact repo map, and Herdr session orchestration while maintaining Universal Tool Contract

title: Evolve context extension to Engram compaction bridge
rationale: Eliminate .pi-context/ repository pollution and automatically bridge active session state into Engram on session_before_compact

name: continuous-context-gc
description: Context pipeline continuously prunes intermediate tool results from older turns (prior to verbatim recent window) on the context event before LLM dispatch. Prevents context bloating and eliminates panic compaction.

title: Effort thinking budget and reasoning effort injection
rationale: Provide dynamic reasoning token injection per sub-goal role without polluting model prompt with JSON tool schemas

name: modular-scheduler-autonomous-extensions
description: Implemented dedicated scheduler extension (.pi/extensions/scheduler/) for timers/cron prompts and autonomous extension (.pi/extensions/autonomous/) for YOLO-loop multi-turn goal tracking and milestone verification with tail injection.

title: Closed-loop quality guardrails for autonomous small models
rationale: Protect small models against context blowups, destructive overwrites, fenced tool-call failures, and patch loops

title: Turn cap and finalize-warn guardrail
rationale: Prevent runaway agent loops and prompt agents to finalize work before budget exhaustion

title: Dynamic skill and knowledge injection
rationale: Static tool docs bloat context on small models; dynamic tail injection with strict token caps delivers targeted guidance without invalidating KV cache

title: Web-tools extension suite
rationale: Empowers headless autonomous agents with low-token web retrieval, browser automation, and code search while strictly bounding context with 5KB artifact spilling

title: Grove extension and hybrid tool gating
rationale: Bridges seeds/mulch/trellis/canopy/roots directly into Pi tools without OS naming collisions while enforcing role and denylist tool gating for defense-in-depth

title: Docs Tools Extension and Fallbacks
rationale: Provide offline and selfhosted document processing tools with minimal LLM context footprint

title: Nu Foundation and Nixpkgs Distribution
rationale: Provide deterministic pure Nix tool distribution and standard Nushell execution primitives without relying on ambient host binaries

title: Nix & Cachix Release Workflow
rationale: Build pure Nix derivations and push to Cachix binary cache instead of ad-hoc archive bundling

name: read-before-edit
description: Read-before-edit invariant: edits on unread files in active session are rejected by quality-stack to enforce fresh linehash anchors and eliminate drift.

name: dual-model-and-continuous-context-economy
description:
Dual-model asymmetric routing (plan-model vs action-model) combined with continuous context garbage collection and dynamic thinking steering.

1. Asymmetric Model Splitting (Volition / GUPPI pattern):
- Plan-model: High-capacity frontier or local reasoning model (e.g. Claude Sonnet/Opus, GPT-5/o3, Qwen 35B high thinking). Owns task decomposition, architecture verification, and episodic summaries. Runs with high thinking budget.
- Action-model: Fast, lower-cost, deterministic execution model (e.g. Qwen 27B/35B minimal thinking, Claude Haiku, GPT-4o-mini). Executes shell pipelines, linehash edits, file reads, and test loops with minimal thinking overhead (1k or off).

2. Dynamic Thinking Budget Steering (lean-ctl pattern):
- Turn-based thinking level modulation: Quick fixes and test commands drop thinking to minimal/off; debugging and architectural plans scale up to medium/high.

3. Continuous 5-Stage Context GC (Sapling pattern):
- Rather than waiting for 90% panic-compaction, prune old tool outputs (>5 turns) down to one-line collapsed summaries while maintaining assistant decisions.

4. Shell Output Scrubbing (lean-ctx pattern):
- Intercept stdout/stderr from CLI tools (test runners, build tools) via Nushell pipelines to strip passing noise, progress bars, and ANSI clutter while keeping stack traces.

title: Dynamic control mechanisms for little-coder running under Warren autonomous c...
rationale:
Dynamic control mechanisms for little-coder running under Warren autonomous container orchestrator:
1. In-Session JSON-RPC steering: session/set_model, session/set_thinking_level, and session/steer commands without restarting container.
2. Turn-level thinking modulation via before_provider_request extension hook: dynamically clamp reasoning effort for mechanical tool runs/verification, escalate on failure analysis.
3. Out-of-band herdr socket inspection: query live context utilization, trigger proactive compaction before overflow.
4. Container-aware event wakeups (session.wake_on): eliminate LLM polling loops by waking on exit, pattern match, or silence.
5. Asymmetric dual-container topology: Warren dispatches high-reasoning Planner container (Sonnet/Qwen 35B high thinking) and lean Worker/Editor container (Qwen 27B minimal thinking) communicating over git-native Grove artifacts.

title: In Warren, each container run corresponds to a fixed-model unit of execution...
rationale: In Warren, each container run corresponds to a fixed-model unit of execution bound to (agent_name, provider, model, cost_basis, cost_usd) for predictive pricing, capacity admission, and accurate billing telemetry. Models often encode reasoning effort via suffixes (e.g. :floor:low). Little-coder respects this macro ceiling while dynamically down-throttling thinking effort to zero or 1024 tokens on purely mechanical turns (test runs, linting, linehash edits) via before_provider_request in the effort extension. Two upstream patches in nixpkg-warren/patches/warren are recommended: 1) first-class thinking field in CronTriggerSchema and buildPiArgv, 2) action_role/action_model handoff in triggers and auto_plan_run for inter-run dual-model composition.

title: Resolved missing consecutive tool compaction and tree glyph rendering in Tool...
rationale: Resolved missing consecutive tool compaction and tree glyph rendering in ToolExecutionComponent. Overrode hasRendererDefinition, getRenderContext.component, and retrofitted first tool of consecutive structural tool group with ┌ prefix and spacer suppression.

title: Cleaned stale enabledModels from user settings in little-coder launcher on st...
rationale: Cleaned stale enabledModels from user settings in little-coder launcher on startup. When enabledModels contained unauthenticated OpenRouter models, pi emitted hundreds of 'Warning: No models match pattern' lines before launching.

title: Adopt Volition-style disk overflow spillover, output machete, and turn veloci...
rationale: Adopt Volition-style disk overflow spillover, output machete, and turn velocity governor in quality-stack. Defer heavier multi-agent intercom/messaging abstractions (pi-intercom, pi-subagents, Dicklesworthstone CLI swarms) in favor of simple Herdr/Warren substrate tools already present (sh, seeds, mulch, engram).

title: Decoupled little-coder into three architectural targets aligned with upstream...
rationale: Decoupled little-coder into three architectural targets aligned with upstream Pi 1.0.3: 1) core: headless @earendil-works/pi-agent-core / @earendil-works/pi-durable with SQLite checkpointing and persistence. 2) tui: developer workstation interactive interface with passive-ui, /statusline, /quickinfo, Starship shell headers, and tree connectors. 3) rpc: Warren container autonomous runner with strict stdout purity and event streaming.
